OKX CMO Haider Rafique Plans to Leave by End of 2026

OKX Global Managing Partner and CMO Haider Rafique plans to leave by the end of 2026, Bloomberg reported, citing people familiar with the matter. Rafique joined OKX in March 2020, led the exchange’s rebranding, and drove partnerships including with the McLaren F1 team and the Tribeca Film Festival. He also helped facilitate Intercontinental Exchange’s $200 million strategic investment in OKX in March, which valued the exchange at $25 billion. Both OKX and Rafique declined to comment. — link

According to Bloomberg, a Coin Metrics report shows that meme coins reach all-time highs an average of 17.2 days after their first trade, with one-quarter peaking within 1.6 days. Singapore Gulf Bank Launches Stablecoin Conversion Services for Retail Banking Customers

Singapore Gulf Bank (SGB) announced that retail customers can use its mobile banking app to convert between U.S. dollars (USD) and USDT or USDC in both directions. Customers do not need to transfer funds to a crypto exchange and can hold USDT, USDC and other fiat currencies in the same bank account. The service is available 24 hours a day from Monday through Friday. Singapore Gulf Bank (SGB), launched by Singapore’s Whampoa Group, is one of Asia’s most important crypto-friendly banks. — link
